scientific_integrity: Originality has been compared against the motivating full-text theorem, a published general action-count bound, a close but differently scoped Latin-square frame theorem, and related effectivity literature. Latin squares and inclusion-exclusion are classical ingredients. Numerical checker tests corroborate but do not replace the mathematical proof. No independent scientific audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite two-agent deterministic games; at a specified state both individual actual-effectivity families must partition the same finite nonempty outcome set and every pair of blocks must intersect. No claims for overlapping neighborhoods, stochastic outcomes, resource optimality under modified action semantics, or unlabeled isomorphism counts. Equivalent older game-form literature may exist.
title: Exact action profiles for partition-valued two-agent effectivity
